turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Leo! Happy Sunday. How is your weekend in Chicago going so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! It's going well, pretty relaxing. I started my morning with a matcha latte to keep my caffeine intake down, like my doctor suggested at my check-up.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's a great choice. A matcha latte is a perfect way to ease up on the caffeine. Are you planning on doing any rock climbing today, or is it a rest day?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Actually, I'm taking a rest day from climbing. I'm just hanging out at the apartment. I did get dressed up a little though—I threw on a button-down shirt today just to feel a bit more put together.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Nice! Sometimes putting on a button-down shirt is all it takes to shift your mindset, even on a lazy Sunday. Did you and Sam end up making any plans for lunch?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sam is out today, so I just grabbed some food on my own. I had ramen for lunch, a vegetarian version from a spot down the street.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Ooh, ramen sounds delicious, especially on a Sunday afternoon. Did you get to relax and listen to some music, or maybe play some guitar?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, I've actually been trying to practice more guitar this afternoon since I have the place to myself. It's been really nice.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a perfect Sunday setup. What have you been working on on the guitar lately?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Just practicing some fingerpicking patterns. It's a nice way to unwind before the busy week starts at the logistics firm tomorrow.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I imagine the logistics firm keeps you pretty busy as an account manager! Are you still doing any running lately, or have you taken a break since finishing the Austin half marathon back in May?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've been doing some light jogging, but definitely not at that intense half marathon training pace anymore. It's nice to just run for fun now.
